title: 22 第22章 方长老23 第23章 阵旗战
content_zh:
任务堂，登记处。
陈大正低头核对任务信息，突然有人跑了大叫一声：“那个叫林轩的回来了，现在正和神威团对峙！”
这一嗓子，顿时惊动了所有任务堂的弟子，他们纷纷放下手中的任务，向外跑去。
虽然他们没有见过林轩，但是林轩的威名他们却听了将近一个月。
一个没有任何背影的外门弟子，竟然敢斩杀神威团的人，而且死的还是内门高手张千的弟弟，这绝对是最近一段时间最火爆的事情。
陈大正早就听说这些事了，但是他只能干着急，现在听到林轩回来了，他更是心急。
想了半天，他只能寻找方长老帮助。
他拿起那修好的宝刀，急匆匆的向后山奔去。
穿过重重殿宇，陈大正来到那幽静的小院前，对着看守弟子施了个礼：“师兄，我有急事求见方长老。”
“哦，是你啊。”
那守门弟子见到是陈大正，笑了笑，“你等着，我给你通报一声。”
陈大正在外面焦急的等着，现在的时间就是生命，晚一秒钟，林轩都有可能被神威团带走，他可不认为林轩能斗得过神威团。
“好了，你跟我来吧。”
在陈大正度秒如年的时候，守门弟子将他领了进去。
弟子陈大正拜见方长老。
陈大正老老实实的拜了一拜。
“什么事？”
方长老淡淡的问道。
陈大正在心急，在长老面前也只能慢慢说道：“这是长老的宝刀，已经被林轩修好了。”
“哦，又是林轩？方长老捋了捋胡子，他回来了吗？”

“回长老，林轩已经回来了，不过现在他被神威团的人围住了，神威团的人硬是说林轩杀了他们的人，现在还要带走林轩！”
“胡闹！”
方长老一听，顿时急了。
“给我带路！”
他抓起陈大正，展动身法，在空中留下一串残影。
……
外门住宿区，唐玉站在林轩身边，双手叉腰，气呼呼的瞪着神威团和执法队的人。
“谁敢带他走，先过了我这关再说！”
林轩想不到这小妞会如此维护他，心中有种暖暖的感觉。
他低声说道：“这次多谢你了。”
“哼！”
唐玉白了他一眼，“说好了入门后姐照着你的，放心吧！”
“那就得罪了！”
华队长寒声道。
他大步走来，身上泛起光华，一只大手向前探来，目标直指林轩。
唐玉小脸微寒，刚欲动手，却被人拉倒身后。
只见林轩一手将她拉倒身后，然后快速拔剑，黑铁剑化成一道电光，瞬间刺出。
林轩一出手就是雷动剑法，剑芒一闪，如同雷电划过，刺向了大手掌。
锵锵！
两者相撞，发出金属相交的声音，林轩刺出三剑，分别刺向了三个不同的位置，但是每次都被那手掌之上的灵力阻挡回来，不过那手掌也因为这三剑而停了下来。

“这就是凝脉六阶吗？好雄厚的灵力！”
林轩感受到对方灵力的强悍，不禁感叹。
这一幕落在众人眼中，顿时引起一片惊呼。
“我没看错吧，他竟然抵住了华队长的一击！”
content_en:
Mission Hall, Registration Office.
Chen Dazheng lowered his head to check the mission information. Suddenly someone ran away and shouted: "The man named Lin Xuan is back and is now confronting the Shenwei Group!"
This voice immediately alerted all the disciples in the task hall. They put down their tasks and ran outside.
Although they have never met Lin Xuan, they have heard about Lin Xuan's reputation for nearly a month.
An outer sect disciple with no trace of his back actually dared to kill someone from the Shenwei Group, and the one who died was the younger brother of the inner sect master Zhang Qian. This is definitely the hottest thing in recent times.
Chen Dazheng had heard about these things a long time ago, but he could only be anxious. Now that he heard that Lin Xuan was back, he was even more anxious.
After thinking for a long time, he could only seek help from Elder Fang.
He picked up the repaired sword and hurried towards the back mountain.
After passing through many palaces, Chen Dazheng came to the quiet courtyard and saluted the guarding disciple: "Brother, I have something urgent to ask to see Elder Fang."
"Oh, it's you."
When the gatekeeper saw it was Chen Dazheng, he smiled and said, "Just wait, I'll let you know."
Chen Dazheng was waiting anxiously outside. Time now is his life. If he is late for a second, Lin Xuan may be taken away by the Shenwei Group. He does not think that Lin Xuan can fight against the Shenwei Group.
"Okay, come with me."
When Chen Dazheng was living for a second like a year, the gatekeeper led him in.
Disciple Chen Dazheng met with Elder Fang.
Chen Dazheng bowed obediently.
"What's the matter?"
Elder Fang asked calmly.
Chen Dazheng was anxious and could only say slowly in front of the elder: "This is the elder's sword, which has been repaired by Lin Xuan."
"Oh, is it Lin Xuan again? Elder Fang stroked his beard. Is he back?"
"Back to the elders, Lin Xuan has returned, but now he is surrounded by people from the Divine Power Group. The people from the Divine Power Group insist that Lin Xuan killed their people, and now they want to take Lin Xuan away!"
"Nonsense!"
When Elder Fang heard this, he immediately became anxious.
"Lead me the way!"
He grabbed Chen Dazheng and used his movement skills, leaving a string of afterimages in the air.
…
In the outer accommodation area, Tang Yu stood beside Lin Xuan, hands on hips, angrily glaring at the members of the Shenwei Group and the Law Enforcement Team.
"Whoever dares to take him away must pass my test first!"
Lin Xuan didn't expect that this girl would defend him so much, and he felt a warm feeling in his heart.
He whispered: "Thank you very much this time."
"Hmph!"
Tang Yu rolled her eyes at him, "We agreed that I will take care of you when I get started, so don't worry!"
"That's offending!"
Captain Hua said coldly.
He strode forward, his body glowing with brilliance, and a big hand reached forward, aiming directly at Lin Xuan.
Tang Yu's face was slightly cold, and he was about to take action, but was pulled down behind him.
Lin Xuan pulled her down behind him with one hand, then quickly drew his sword. The black iron sword turned into a bolt of lightning and stabbed out instantly.
Lin Xuan used his thunderous sword technique as soon as he took action. The sword flashed like lightning and struck the big palm.
Clang!
The two collided, making the sound of metal intersecting. Lin Xuan thrust out three swords, piercing three different positions respectively, but each time he was blocked by the spiritual power on the palm, but the palm also stopped because of these three swords.
"Is this the sixth level of pulse condensation? Such strong spiritual power!"
Lin Xuan felt the strength of the other party's spiritual power and couldn't help but sigh.
This scene fell into the eyes of everyone and immediately caused an exclamation of surprise.
"Did I read that correctly? He actually withstood Captain Hua's blow!"
